name: MAI-Voice-2.1
description: MAI-Voice-2.1 is our highest-fidelity, most expressive text-to-speech model, delivering rich, natural speech across 23 languages. It extends the MAI-Voice family with broad multilingual coverage, gated instant voice cloning, and strong long-form generation capabilities. With its detailed prosody, nuanced expressiveness, and studio-grade audio quality, MAI-Voice-2.1 is ideal for experiences where maximum voice quality and fidelity are required - long-form narration, brand-defining audio etc.
